knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A filler that hides movement leaves the joint unstabilised. The joint itself must be assessed and repaired.
Adhesive reaches its designed strength only after the cure time, so load is held back until then.
Even pressure from a press or cauls, lifting only where needed, avoids crushing and cracking the veneer.

practicalCriteria: Condition assessed and photographed before repair
Joint stabilised, with no filler used to hide movement
Clamping even, with no veneer crushed
Cure time observed and recorded before the repair takes load
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80% or higher. With three checks this means all three must be correct. Practical sign-off is separate: every practical criterion must be observed and met by the assessor. A knowledge pass is not practical competence and does not count toward sign-off.
evidenceRequired: Condition record with photographs before repair
Adhesive or filler product and cure time
stopWorkCriteria: Filler used to hide a moving joint
